description:
Human-Intelligence is not fully against the use of AI.

We are ABSOLUTELY accepting team members.

Our goal is to visualize and detect the "trends" that Earth seems to go trough and signify the results back to the users of our project. (Our secondary goal is to see if our findings match with what the headlines call significant.
summary:
My project focuses on measuring how much global warming and other earthly trends affect a certain place with mean data from providers such as NASA Power, Meteomatics Copernicus Data Ecosystem.
I believe this is important to gather unique data for all regions so they can take actions that suite them best. 
Our project also includes economical affect by finding demand for AC and other climate control devices.
details: Our project utilizes the Mix model from meteomatics to gather data. It's coded in pure python and the standalone app is optimized for efficient devices (Aarch64). Our project can also be used with a python interpreter on a x86 Windows, Ubuntu or any other OS that supports Python 15 or above. We hope this project helps each community see and reflect on the actions they took to fight climate change and influence future decisions.
